plain_language_idea: Test whether BTCUSDT distance from a slow SMA mean reverts when volatility is elevated and the longer trend filter agrees.

market_hypothesis.claim: Large normalized deviations from a slow BTCUSDT centerline tend to mean revert conditionally.
market_hypothesis.causal_rationale: Short-lived positioning pressure can dislocate price from a slow centerline before liquidity normalizes.
market_hypothesis.observable_prediction: Extreme completed-bar deviations followed by next-bar entries have positive out-of-sample expectancy after costs.

entry_exit_concept.entry: At a completed bar, enter against an extreme normalized deviation when the trend filter agrees; fill at next bar open.
entry_exit_concept.exit: Exit when price returns to the completed-bar centerline or a preregistered maximum holding period expires.

risk_logic_concept.exit_risk_logic: Use only preregistered research exit assumptions and report adverse excursion.

parameter_ranges.name: center_lookback_bars
parameter_ranges.rationale: Bounded around slow centerlines supported by the source Strategy Spec family.

expected_edge_mechanism: Temporary positioning pressure mean reverts after a completed-bar extreme while a slow trend filter limits adverse regimes.
failure_modes: Persistent trends can continue through the deviation threshold.
Trading costs can consume a weak gross edge.
overfit_risks: Choosing a narrow lookback combination after observing OOS results.
Treating nearby grid points as independent hypotheses.
validation_requirements: Pre-register the complete bounded grid and multiple-testing denominator.
Use walk-forward OOS evaluation with costs and sensitivity review.
stop_conditions: Stop if the complete bounded grid fails preregistered OOS thresholds.
Stop if results depend on one isolated parameter point.
